name: Eero Heinäluoma - Projet de décision du Conseil
title: RECOMMENDATION on the draft Council decision on the conclusion, on behalf of the European Union, of the Agreement between the European Union and the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland regarding cooperation on the application of their respective competition laws
part_text:
The European Parliament has approved a deal between the European Union and the United Kingdom on how the two sides work together when enforcing their competition laws. Competition law stops companies from teaming up to fix prices or abusing a dominant market position. The agreement sets out how the two authorities cooperate on cases that touch both markets. Parliament's approval was the step needed for the deal to be concluded.

- The EU and the UK agree to cooperate when enforcing their competition rules.
- It affects companies operating in both the EU and UK markets.
- The agreement can now be concluded; Parliament's role is complete.
